strongest_counterhypothesis: A conventional immutable base + sparse branch overlays + exact self/epoch/revision/hypothesis/provenance metadata + memoization keyed by transition identity and exact pure read signature reproduces PSW's useful state and computation sharing with less architecture. Materialized worlds should be used when signature diversity becomes high.
evidence: Across all 168 scaling cells, SPARSE_OVERLAY_MEMO and PSW used exactly the same number of distinct pure-transition evaluations because both partitioned branches by the same exact read signature.

Median PSW time / OVERLAY_MEMO time was 1.00937; overlay memo was faster in 103 cells and PSW in 65, consistent with implementation-level constant factors rather than a distinct algorithmic advantage.
PSW wire metadata was a median 1.01518x the ordinary overlay representation in the benchmark.
Low-divergence sharing is highly valuable relative to FULL_COPY, but ordinary overlay+memo captures it.

At F=1024,N=256,read16, median sharing factor falls from 256x at 0% divergence to 6.83x at 1%, 1.76x at 5%, 1.20x at 10%, 1.01x at 25%, and 1x at 50%; overlay memo becomes slower than FULL_COPY in the high-divergence regime.

An exact-read-set lesion shows that any memo/lifting implementation becomes unsound if a material read is omitted, so the real hard requirement lies in ClayCode pure/read-effect completeness rather than a PSW-specific state object.
Concurrent ACEF candidate already models hypothesis branches as epoch/identity/lease-bound SemanticDelta sets, increasing duplication risk for any new PSW branch-state organ.
durable_result: Preserve a measured representation/runtime envelope: sparse overlay/delta state + exact read-signature pure memoization in low-signature-diversity regimes; independent/materialized execution when signature diversity is high; maintain exact branch identity/provenance/epoch semantics throughout. Treat this as an implementation policy consumable by Hyperposition/ACEF, not a second branch semantics.
reopen_condition: Reopen PSW only if current ClayCode/Frank implementation evidence shows a safety/static-completeness/resource benefit not reproducible by the conventional overlay+memo representation, or if real Hyperposition traces expose a branch topology that overlays/ACEF deltas cannot represent exactly.
